comment: The scope excludes electronic medical records, order-management systems, warehouse-management systems, and disease-specific tools because they consume shared infrastructure. This boundary is conceptually useful, but the document does not provide a consistent test for mixed platforms that implement both shared and operational capabilities.

public.text: The scope excludes electronic medical records, order-management systems, warehouse-management systems, and disease-specific tools because they consume shared infrastructure. This boundary is conceptually useful, but the document does not provide a consistent test for mixed platforms that implement both shared and operational capabilities.
public.suggestedRevision: Add guidance stating that DPI-H classification applies to the relevant capability or logical component, not necessarily to an entire deployed product. A single platform may realise both DPI-H components and operational applications, but the responsibilities and interfaces must remain logically separable.
